gloss: predawn; before daybreak; early morning hours

definitions.gloss: predawn; before daybreak; early morning hours
definitions.explanation: The hours after midnight but before dawn — roughly from around 3 a.m. until first light. Common in news reports and weather forecasts to indicate when something occurred in the dark hours of early morning.

examples.japanese: {未明|みめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた→降り始める：22638_furihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: It began to rain in the predawn hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧{未明|みめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The accident occurred in the early morning hours today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未明|みめい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: Snow is expected from the predawn hours into early morning tomorrow across many regions.

notes:
Literally 'not yet bright' — ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + {明|めい} (bright). Most often heard in news and weather reports as a precise time-window for events occurring after midnight but before sunrise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧{未明|みめい}: in the early hours of today
- {未明|みめい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧: from predawn through daybreak
- {未明|みめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to occur in the predawn hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧: dawn; just before sunrise (slightly later than {未明|みめい})
- ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧: middle of the night (centered around midnight)
- ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧: early morning (after dawn, while still early)
- ⟦{暁|あかつき}→暁：10036_akatsuki⟧: daybreak (literary)
